items.note: S1.1 states (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch, and the sub-steps follow the paper's route (eight-row restoring schedule, central gather/scatter with side cancellation, forward/inverse/forward composition, lines 741-764). The actual neighbour rules and central coefficients (|S cap T| mod 2, (|S cap T|-1)/2) and h=100 are not given, so the cancellation is only asserted generically.

S1.2 gives frames D_v, edge operators D_vD_u^{-1}, commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, matching eq:common-frame-identity. The per-route form eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} is not spelled out.

Plan states the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, the form x^T(I-J/9)y / F_2 dot product with orthogonal neighbouring triple lines, the only decreasing edges losing h, and the loss ratios 100/539, 101/539. The stage transitions and terminal labels, and the source/sink dimension count (N and Wm-N) that yields Wm-2N, are absent.

S1.5 states projection frames, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, endpoint difference I_m on every role and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b<W_bm, as in Prop. bit-motif-interface. The rank argument (P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U; source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, lines 1158-1165) is not given.

S1.6 has one two-point kernel per residual basis vector, s_c<W_cm, and telescoping to C^{tensor m} on every role. It does not define C_U or the kernel aI+bX_v, omits the formula s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c, and omits the diagonal corrections needed before the endpoints become C^{tensor m} (lines 1225-1227, 1304-1314).
Plan has L/N<1/2, s_b<W_bm, s_c<W_cm, and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. It omits the deficits eta_b, eta_c and the argument eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20 that gives s/W<m^tau (lines 1331-1343).
Elementary streams and controlled shifts appear only as relies-on labels and in 'lower triangular updates run in tape order'; no operation or O(V) cost statement is given.

S2.1 states A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and S2.2 the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V), both correct. The justification covers only the O(V) triangular updates; the elimination proof of the factorization and the one-interchange realization of each one of Pi (lines 1432-1443) are missing.

Plan follows the paper's route: cyclic row split into W role streams, bit network with shear frames, edges by rank-many recursive interchanges, shear H<-H+D, two linear updates to finish, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), F_k=O(e^tau). The fixed-tape depth-first schedule giving O(V) per node (lines 1559-1615) and the geometric-sum step are absent.

S2/S2.4 state O(Vu^tau) for two u-bit chunks of any shape. S2.4 adds only 'high digits as rows and handling general widths', not the rho high digits, padding to W^k, or base-m pieces of lines 1649-1762, so it counts as stated, not derived.

Plan has binary basis changes, s child calls on volume V/W, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D (correct). Missing are the conjugation by P_M that puts residual directions on coordinate slots, the child size e/m with C^{tensor f}, and the handling of inverse kernels by one forward call (eq:phase-inverse-child).

S3.2 describes the mechanism (constant number of whole-chunk cyclic shifts, then repair of a bounded exceptional set) but gives no bad-set fraction delta_bad or cost bound O(V(L^tau+1)), which are its defining content.

S3.3 states F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and that it unrolls to O(d^{lambda'}), matching line 2407. It omits the leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the condition max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda'<1, and the base-m pieces.

Statement matches Prop. simultaneous-layer (D<=d chunks, O(Vd^{lambda'}), Q_p(Hz) with error <sqrt2 2^{-p}), and the sub-steps follow the proof's route: phase wrappers, recursion with packed basis changes, guard widths, single truncation. The guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) and the uniform packed-cost check are not stated (S3.4 is only a heading).

S4.2 gives the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+ell d^{lambda'}]) and the retained stored order, and S4.1 gives powers of y as roots of unity. Missing are F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I, the layout L with exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the error sqrt2 ell 2^{-p}.

S4.3 states Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp)) via signed Kronecker packing. It says one call to the multiplier, but the proof makes four products A_aA_c, A_bA_e, A_aA_e, A_bA_c (lines 3249-3252), and it omits B_0=2^{4p} and centered residues.

S4 states the error sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^{-p} and the cost, with packed products added separately, matching Prop. synthetic-convolution. The method (two forward transforms in retained layout, pointwise packed products, opposite transform) follows the paper. It omits the identity P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v) that justifies keeping the layout, and the exact scale by M.

S5.1 gives P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions and error below p^2 (correct). It omits the hypothesis theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4, the cost O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha), and the tensor form RF_s=2^gamma B_0 QF_t A, which S5.2 gives only in words.
S5.4 gives (u*v)/S^2 correctly, and S5.3 describes QF_t in words as chirp-convolution-chirp. The chirp a_j and the normalization a*(conj(a).u)/T are not given.

S9.1 lists tau=sigma, lambda', c, epsilon, delta, kappa correctly, and S9 has d~p^eps, K~d^c. Missing are b, p=6b, T, Tp=Theta(n), lambda, and the prime source lengths s_i with (1-2eta)t_i<s_i<=(1-eta)t_i.

S6 states x->prod x_i^{mu_i} as an algebra isomorphism preserving cyclic convolution, implemented by triangular controlled shifts. It does not define mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i or give the triangular digit formula.
S7 gives the twist by zeta^k with zeta=e^{pi i/r}, carrying cyclic convolution mod x^r-1 to negacyclic multiplication, as at lines 4303-4319.

The pipeline is listed in S's method and the source transform is discussed in S5. The composed source transform 2^gamma B_0 QF_t A and the six-step algorithm with its scalings by S and 2^{2b+4}S are not stated.
S8 states a coefficient error below 1/2, then rounding and carries, which is the key conclusion. The error chain (E_s, E_w, 448b 2^{-3b/4}) and the conditions p=6b, gamma<=b/4 are missing.

Plan has seven margins with minimum 2^{-181}=2kappa from the chunk exchanges (g_2), log-power absorption by p^kappa, and O(Tp p^{1-kappa})=O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}), as in the paper. The normalized cost list itself (dK, pK^{tau-1}, ell d^{lambda'}, ...) and the margin formulas g_i are not given.
The n log n conjecture appears only as a relies-on label of S. No step says that one machine with liminf T(n)/(n lg n)=0 negates it.

errors.says: Signed Kronecker packing computes Q_p(fg/r) with one call to the O(N log N) multiplier.
errors.paper: The proof multiplies four pairs of evaluation integers (A_aA_c, A_bA_e, A_aA_e, A_bA_c) with the established multiplier.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: scalar exchange network, frames, labels, budget and L<N/2, bit and complex interfaces, then s/W<m^tau driving both recurrences, through the two tape procedures, convolution, resampling/chirp/CRT/twist, exact recovery and the margin computation. It thins out after the interchange recurrence: the butterfly-layer recursion (P_M conjugation, packed addition costs, guard widths), the transform layout, and the error chain for exact recovery are given as conclusions rather than derived. Most of the defining formulas there (chirp, mu_i, normalized cost list) are missing.

steps.note: S1.1 gives the bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring scratch wires. The data setup that defines the network (h=100, banks indexed by triple triples, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3) is absent, so this is counted conservatively as mentioned.
S1.2 has the common invertible frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, and the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}.
S1.3 attaches nested nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional tensor-cube label space, and S1.3.2 says the only decreasing edges are the central-wire edges, each losing h.
The plan says an edge costs in proportion to its rank and the residual dimension. It never states that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U or that the N source edges are rank-one exceptions.
S1.3 gives sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and S1.5 gives s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b.
S1.4 gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2. S1.5 quotes the deficit N-2L_b>0 and gives s_b<W_bm.
S1.5 has endpoint difference I_m on every role from the -P_{U_a} sources, and S2's method gets the shear H<-H+D on all role streams.
S2.1 gives the factorization E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and S2.2 the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V). S2.3 gives s recursive calls per node.

S2.3 gives children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and F_k=O(e^tau), and S1.7 gives s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. The justification from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 is missing, a borderline case.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs most of the central chain: frames, nested labels with only the central edges decreasing, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving the shear, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence to O(e^tau) with tau=1-2^{-50}. It is weak at two points. The concrete network data (h=100, triple indexing, N, m) are absent. The link 'rank of P_V-P_U equals the dimension change, with N rank-one source exceptions' is only alluded to. It also does not justify why s/W<m^tau.
